lead: Cristóbal de Villalpando was a Baroque Criollo artist from New Spain, arts administrator and captain of the guard.
paras: He painted prolifically and produced many Baroque works now displayed in several Mexican cathedrals, including the cathedrals in Querétaro, Puebla and Mexico City, as well as a depiction of the Zócalo in Mexico City, showing the damage of the 1692 riot to the viceregal palace three years earlier.
